lessons.title: Earnings, tax and savings
lessons.label: Earnings, tax and savings

notation.spoken: Find the money left after tax and savings

lessons.objective: Apply a tax-free allowance, calculate tax on the excess, then save a fraction of the after-tax income.
prerequisites: Calculate a percentage and a fraction of an amount.

curriculum.title: GCSE Mathematics 1MA1 — Ratio, Proportion and Rates of Change

tutorNotes.observe: Pause at each step and ask the student to explain the calculation.
tutorNotes.misconception: Taxing the full salary, or calculating savings from the salary before tax.
tutorNotes.checkQuestion: Which amount is taxed, and which amount is the savings fraction applied to?

steps.title: Read the question
steps.explanation: Jessica earns {{income|money}} pounds per year. She pays {{taxRate}}% tax on earnings over {{allowance|money}} pounds, then saves {{numerator}}/{{denominator}} of the rest. How much is left?
steps.detail: Use the simplified tax rule stated in this question.

scene.caption: All bars use the original annual earnings as the same scale.

steps.title: Subtract the tax-free allowance

left.text: The first {{allowance|money}} pounds is not taxed. Only {{taxable|money}} pounds is taxable.
left.spoken: The first {{allowance|money}} pounds is not taxed. Only {{taxable|money}} pounds is taxable.

steps.explanation: The first {{allowance|money}} pounds is not taxed. Only {{taxable|money}} pounds is taxable.

scene.description: Tax-free allowance: {{allowance|money}} pounds. Taxable earnings: {{taxable|money}} pounds.
scene.caption: All bars use the original annual earnings as the same scale.

steps.title: Calculate tax on the excess

left.text: Find {{taxRate}}% of the taxable earnings, giving {{tax|money}} pounds in tax. Do not tax the allowance.
left.spoken: Find {{taxRate}}% of the taxable earnings, giving {{tax|money}} pounds in tax. Do not tax the allowance.

steps.explanation: Find {{taxRate}}% of the taxable earnings, giving {{tax|money}} pounds in tax. Do not tax the allowance.

scene.caption: All bars use the original annual earnings as the same scale.

steps.title: Find the amount after tax

left.text: Subtract the tax from the full annual earnings. Jessica has {{afterTax|money}} pounds after tax, including her tax-free allowance.
left.spoken: Subtract the tax from the full annual earnings. Jessica has {{afterTax|money}} pounds after tax, including her tax-free allowance.

steps.explanation: Subtract the tax from the full annual earnings. Jessica has {{afterTax|money}} pounds after tax, including her tax-free allowance.

scene.caption: All bars use the original annual earnings as the same scale.

steps.title: Find one equal savings share

left.text: The savings fraction applies to the after-tax amount. Divide {{afterTax|money}} pounds into {{denominator}} equal shares of {{share|money}} pounds.
left.spoken: The savings fraction applies to the after-tax amount. Divide {{afterTax|money}} pounds into {{denominator}} equal shares of {{share|money}} pounds.

steps.explanation: The savings fraction applies to the after-tax amount. Divide {{afterTax|money}} pounds into {{denominator}} equal shares of {{share|money}} pounds.

scene.description: After tax: {{afterTax|money}} pounds. One equal share: {{share|money}} pounds.
scene.caption: All bars use the original annual earnings as the same scale.

steps.title: Calculate the savings

left.text: Save {{numerator}} shares, totalling {{savings|money}} pounds. This money is set aside.
left.spoken: Save {{numerator}} shares, totalling {{savings|money}} pounds. This money is set aside.

steps.explanation: Save {{numerator}} shares, totalling {{savings|money}} pounds. This money is set aside.

scene.caption: All bars use the original annual earnings as the same scale.

steps.title: Subtract savings to find what is left

left.text: Jessica has {{left|money}} pounds left to spend after paying tax and setting aside her savings. Tax, savings and money left add back to her original earnings.
left.spoken: Jessica has {{left|money}} pounds left to spend after paying tax and setting aside her savings. Tax, savings and money left add back to her original earnings.
